info.name: Decidiq ORI public votes
info.description: Anonymous reads of the ORI persons, votes and voteevents resources (bodies-member-profile-and-voting-record tasks 4 and 5). Read-only: it seeds and changes nothing. The console lines record the anonymous count per resource, the measurement task 4 asks for. A vote carries only voter, option, vote event and group; a vote event carries totals only; ?voter= narrows; an unknown id is 404.

exec: pm.test('answers 200 to an anonymous caller', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('lists items with a count', () => { pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(body.items.length); });
console.log('anonymous persons count', body.count);
pm.test('answers 200 to an anonymous caller', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('lists items with a count', () => { pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(body.items.length); });
console.log('anonymous votes count', body.count);
pm.test('a vote carries only the published fields', () => body.items.forEach((v) => pm.expect(Object.keys(v)).to.have.members(['@context', '@type', 'id', 'voter', 'option', 'vote_event', 'group'])));
pm.test('a vote option is yes, no or abstain', () => body.items.forEach((v) => pm.expect(['yes', 'no', 'abstain']).to.include(v.option)));
if (body.items.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('voteId', body.items[0].id); pm.collectionVariables.set('voterId', body.items[0].voter || ''); }
pm.test('answers 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
const voter = pm.collectionVariables.get('voterId');
pm.test('?voter= narrows to that person', () => body.items.forEach((v) => { if (voter) { pm.expect(v.voter).to.eql(voter); } }));
pm.test('answers 200 to an anonymous caller', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('lists items with a count', () => { pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.count).to.eql(body.items.length); });
console.log('anonymous voteevents count', body.count);

pm.test('a vote event carries totals and no per-member value', () => body.items.forEach((e) => { pm.expect(e.counts).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(e).to.not.have.property('votes'); pm.expect(e).to.not.have.property('participant'); }));
pm.test('an unknown vote id is not found', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
